summary: This directory manages the storage, retrieval, and structural definition of versioned prompt templates. It defines the interface for repository services and provides file-based implementations for persisting and accessing prompt definitions and their associated version history.
responsibilities: Defining the structural schema for prompt definitions and versions
Providing an interface for prompt repository management
Implementing file-based storage and retrieval of prompt data
Handling prompt metadata and versioning lifecycle
relationships: The prompt repository service defines the contract for managing prompt definitions which contain multiple prompt versions.
Data schemas enforce the structure of prompt definitions and versions used during storage and retrieval operations.
The file repository service implements the repository interface to bridge the gap between persistent YAML files and the application runtime.
designDecisions: Schema-driven validation for prompt data structures
Layered implementation separating the contract from file system access
